messages:
clara: Hey support — after rotating our API key via the console and updating our k8s secret with Helm, our service started getting 401s: `invalid_api_key`. Worked for a couple requests then boom. Anyone seen this with Helm values formatting?

josh: Hi Clara — can you paste the exact curl you ran and the full response body (no redaction except the key itself)? :thinking:

clara: sure, repro:```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" https://api.redwood-infer.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```response:```HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{\"error\":\"invalid_api_key\",\"message\":\"API key not recognized\"}
```

maya: quick checks: length of the header string? any leading/trailing whitespace or newline from the k8s secret? Helm sometimes uses `|` literal blocks which can add a trailing `\n`. Can you run `printf '%s' \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | wc -c` in the pod?

clara: ran in the pod: `printf '%s' \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | wc -c` => `41`
our old key was 40 chars. hmmm.

josh: that points to an extra char. Also try `hexdump -C <<<\"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | head` to see hidden bytes.

clara: output:```
00000000  61 42 3a 6a 2d 4f 7a 9f  6c 2b 34 5a 37 6b 38 71  |aB:j-Oz.l+4Z7k8q|
00000010  0a                                                |.|
00000011
```so there's a `0a` (newline) at the end. :facepalm:

tina: yup that's the classic Helm `|` literal block newline. In values.yaml people do: `apiKey: |\n  ABC...` which preserves a trailing newline. Redwood API key matching is exact (no trimming), so the newline breaks the signature string.

clara: where should we change it? Our chart uses:```yaml
secrets:
  redwood_api_key: |
    {{ .Values.redwood.apiKey }}
```

maya: change the template to use `trim` or `nindent` to avoid the trailing newline, or store the value without `|` in values.yaml. Example template fix:```yaml
redwood_api_key: {{ .Values.redwood.apiKey | quote }}
```or if you must keep block literal, strip in the pod entrypoint: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(printf '%s' \"$REDWOOD_API_KEY\" | tr -d '\n')`.

josh: also added a quick server-side check to improve error messaging for trailing whitespace in api keys (ENG-RUNTIME-452). Won't accept whitespace, but we'll log a specific hint to help customers.

clara: patched our Helm and redeployed, re-run `hexdump` shows no `0a`. Requests now return 200. :white_check_mark: Thanks all.

tina: leaving a note: docs/helm.md should include a snippet about not using literal blocks for api keys. I'll open a tiny docs PR.

deploy-bot: deploy/redwood-infra/helm-chart v3.2.1 -> v3.2.2 deployed by clara (canary) :rocket:

maya: great root cause captured. Filing a short support KB: \"401 after Helm secret update — trailing newline in block literal\" and link to fix.

clara: KB would be awesome. Saved us a lot of time.

josh: marking resolved. If anyone else hits this, ask them to run the hexdump check first.

(threads end)
